nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Vite HTML shell for the main management dashboard: mounts the React app from src/main.tsx into #root, sets the navy theme color, and marks the private login shell noindex/nofollow.

nodes.name: order.html
nodes.summary: Vite HTML shell for the separate customer-facing Order app, mounting src/order/main.tsx into #root with the same viewport and favicon setup as the dashboard.

nodes.name: overhaul_prompt.md
nodes.summary: Long-form agent brief describing a planned dashboard overhaul: stack conventions, a feature-sliced folder layout (app/pages/widgets/features/entities/shared), API regeneration steps, and page-by-page requirements. The paths it references (src/app/router, src/shared/*) do not match the current tree, so it is historical planning material.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: NPM manifest defining the dashboard, demo, order, and marketing (get) Vite build/dev scripts, Tauri and Orval commands, linting/formatting, and the React 19 / TanStack / Radix / Tailwind dependency set.
nodes.languageNotes: Multiple Vite configs (vite.order.config.ts, vite.get.config.ts) drive separate bundles from one package; VITE_MOCK/VITE_DEMO env flags switch MSW mocking and demo mode.

nodes.name: skills-lock.json
nodes.summary: Lockfile pinning the installed Claude Code skill 'remotion-best-practices' from remotion-dev/skills by content hash.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler config for the app source: ES2022 target, bundler resolution, strict mode with unused-checks, react-jsx, the @/* path alias to src/, and src/order excluded from this project.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: Composite TypeScript project covering only vite.config.ts so Node-side build tooling is type-checked separately from the browser app.
